title: Ask, Never Demand: The First Asking

texts.details:
You have your first totems, young one. You carry them well. Now learn what they are not.

They are not tools. Our people have spoken with the spirits of earth and sky since before the oldest story, and it was tauren who first gathered the Earthen Ring, to keep the peace between the elements and those who walk upon them. In all that time we have never once commanded them. We ask, as one asks an elder.

Something has roused a spirit of the wind on the plain south-east of the village. It is angry, and it does not know at whom. Go to it. It will strike at you. Do not answer anger with anger. Stand, and let it wear itself out.
texts.objectives: Wear out the anger of the Roused Spirit of Wind, on the plain south-east of Bloodhoof Village, then return to your teacher.
texts.progress: You cannot kill a spirit. You can only outlast its anger.
texts.completion:
It is still? Good. It is not dead; the wind does not die. It has gone back to the sky, and it will remember that you stood and did not curse it.

That is the whole of our way, $N. A shaman asks. A shaman never demands. The elements are not servants, and not all of them are kind. They lend, and they can cease to lend.

The world is full of those who demanded instead. Some of them are our own kin, to our shame. I would have you see what became of each. Choose one of these. When you have twenty seasons, cross to Orgrimmar and seek the orc Kardris Dreamseeker in the Valley of Wisdom.

idea: Ask, Never Demand, level 10 (Horde): one roused spirit near home, and the rule that a shaman asks. Invented: the spirit.
